lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾ ਕਰਮਾਤਿ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤੁਠੈ ਜੋ ਮਿਲੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak saa karamaat saahib tuthai jo milai ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, that is the most wonderful gift, which is received from the Lord, when He is totally pleased. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahalaa 2 ||
lines.translation: Second Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਹ ਕਿਨੇਹੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਭਉ ਖਸਮ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: eh kinehee chaakaree jit bhau khasam na jaai ||
lines.translation: What sort of service is this, by which the fear of the Lord Master does not depart?

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਕਾਢੀਐ ਜਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਖਸਮ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sevak kaadheeai j setee khasam samaai ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, he alone is called a servant, who merges with the Lord Master. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਤ ਨ ਜਾਪਨੑੀ ਹਰਿ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak a(n)t na jaapanhee har taa ke paaraavaar ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Lord's limits cannot be known; He has no end or limitation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਸਾਖਤੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਮਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap karaae saakhatee phir aap karaae maar ||
lines.translation: He Himself creates, and then He Himself destroys.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਨੑਾ ਗਲੀ ਜੰਜੀਰੀਆ ਇਕਿ ਤੁਰੀ ਚੜਹਿ ਬਿਸੀਆਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikanhaa galee ja(n)jeereeaa ik turee chaRahi biseeaar ||
lines.translation: Some have chains around their necks, while some ride on many horses.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰੇ ਆਪਿ ਹਉ ਕੈ ਸਿਉ ਕਰੀ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap karaae kare aap hau kai siu karee pukaar ||
lines.translation: He Himself acts, and He Himself causes us to act. Unto whom should I complain?

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰ ॥੨੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak karanaa jin keeaa phir tis hee karanee saar ||23||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the One who created the creation - He Himself takes care of it. ||23||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਭਾਂਡੇ ਸਾਜਿਅਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਪੂਰਣੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape bhaa(n)de saajian aape pooran dei ||
lines.translation: He Himself fashioned the vessel of the body, and He Himself fills it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਨੑੀ ਦੁਧੁ ਸਮਾਈਐ ਇਕਿ ਚੁਲੑੈ ਰਹਨੑਿ ਚੜੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikanhee dudh samaaeeai ik chulhai rahanhi chaRe ||
lines.translation: Into some, milk is poured, while others remain on the fire.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੀ ਪੈ ਸਵਨੑਿ ਇਕਿ ਉਪਰਿ ਰਹਨਿ ਖੜੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik nihaalee pai savanhi ik upar rahan khaRe ||
lines.translation: Some lie down and sleep on soft beds, while others remain watchful.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨੑਾ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tinhaa savaare naanakaa jinh kau nadar kare ||1||
lines.translation: He adorns those, O Nanak, upon whom He casts His Glance of Grace. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahalaa 2 ||
lines.translation: Second Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਜੇ ਕਰੇ ਆਪਿ ਜਾਈ ਭਿ ਰਖੈ ਆਪਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape saaje kare aap jaaee bh rakhai aap ||
lines.translation: He Himself creates and fashions the world, and He Himself keeps it in order.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਦੇਖੈ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis vich ja(n)t upaai kai dekhai thaap uthaap ||
lines.translation: Having created the beings within it, He oversees their birth and death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kis no kaheeai naanakaa sabh kichh aape aap ||2||
lines.translation: Unto whom should we speak, O Nanak, when He Himself is all-in-all? ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡੇ ਕੀਆ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vade keeaa vadiaaeeaa kichh kahanaa kahan na jaai ||
lines.translation: The description of the greatness of the Great Lord cannot be described.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਾਦਰ ਕਰੀਮੁ ਦੇ ਜੀਆ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸੰਬਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: so karataa kaadar kareem de jeeaa rijak sa(n)baahi ||
lines.translation: He is the Creator, all-powerful and benevolent; He gives sustenance to all beings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਈ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਧੁਰਿ ਛੋਡੀ ਤਿੰਨੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saaee kaar kamaavanee dhur chhodee ti(n)nai paai ||
lines.translation: The mortal does that work, which has been pre-destined from the very beginning.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੀ ਬਾਹਰੀ ਹੋਰ ਦੂਜੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak ekee baaharee hor doojee naahee jaai ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, except for the One Lord, there is no other place at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਜਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੨੪॥੧॥ ਸੁਧੁ
lines.transliteration: so kare j tisai rajaai ||24||1|| sudh
lines.translation: He does whatever He wills. ||24||1|| Sudh||

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag aasaa baanee bhagataa kee ||
lines.translation: Raag Aasaa, The Word Of The Devotees:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਜੀਉ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer jeeu naamadeu jeeu ravidaas jeeu ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, Naam Dayv And Ravi Daas.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa sree kabeer jeeu ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Kabeer Jee:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਲਾਗਿ ਹਮ ਬਿਨਵਤਾ ਪੂਛਤ ਕਹ ਜੀਉ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur charan laag ham binavataa poochhat kah jeeu paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Falling at the Feet of the Guru, I pray, and ask Him, "Why was man created?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਕਾਜਿ ਜਗੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਕਹਹੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਮਝਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kavan kaaj jag upajai binasai kahahu mohi samajhaaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: What deeds cause the world to come into being, and be destroyed? Tell me, that I may understand." ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਵ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਭੈ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੂਟੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: dev karahu daiaa mohi maarag laavahu jit bhai ba(n)dhan tootai ||
lines.translation: O Divine Guru, please, show Mercy to me, and place me on the right path, by which the bonds of fear may be cut away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੁਖ ਫੇੜ ਕਰਮ ਸੁਖ ਜੀਅ ਜਨਮ ਤੇ ਛੂਟੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam maran dukh pheR karam sukh jee janam te chhootai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The pains of birth and death come from past actions and karma; peace comes when the soul finds release from reincarnation. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਫਾਸ ਬੰਧ ਨਹੀ ਫਾਰੈ ਅਰੁ ਮਨ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਨ ਲੂਕੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa phaas ba(n)dh nahee phaarai ar man su(n)n na looke ||
lines.translation: The mortal does not break free from the bonds of the noose of Maya, and he does not seek the shelter of the profound, absolute Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਾ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੑਿਆ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਅਭਿਉ ਨ ਚੂਕੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: aapaa pad nirabaan na cheenhiaa in bidh abhiu na chooke ||2||
lines.translation: He does not realize the dignity of the self, and Nirvaanaa; because of this, his doubt does not depart. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੀ ਨ ਉਪਜੈ ਉਪਜੀ ਜਾਣੈ ਭਾਵ ਅਭਾਵ ਬਿਹੂਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahee na upajai upajee jaanai bhaav abhaav bihoonaa ||
lines.translation: The soul is not born, even though he thinks it is born; it is free from birth and death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਦੈ ਅਸਤ ਕੀ ਮਨ ਬੁਧਿ ਨਾਸੀ ਤਉ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਲਿਵ ਲੀਣਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: udai asat kee man budh naasee tau sadaa sahaj liv leenaa ||3||
lines.translation: When the mortal gives up his ideas of birth and death, he remains constantly absorbed in the Lord's Love. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਬਿੰਬੁ ਬਿੰਬ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੀ ਹੈ ਉਦਕ ਕੁੰਭੁ ਬਿਗਰਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu pratibi(n)b bi(n)b kau milee hai udak ku(n)bh bigaraanaa ||
lines.translation: As the reflection of an object blends in the water when the pitcher is broken,

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਐਸਾ ਗੁਣ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਤਉ ਮਨੁ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਸਮਾਨਾਂ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kahu kabeer aisaa gun bhram bhaagaa tau man su(n)n samaanaa(n) ||4||1||
lines.translation: says Kabeer, just so virtue dispels doubt, and then the soul is absorbed in the profound, absolute Lord. ||4||1||
